result.summary: Backports PR #35878 to the 31.x maintenance branch. It modifies net_processing to process only unique transaction inventory advertisements from peers, avoiding redundant processing for conflicting transactions.
result.problem: Nodes running the 31.x branch process duplicate or conflicting transaction advertisements from peers, performing spurious work on transactions that cannot both enter the mempool.
evidence: Commit message: 'There is no reason we should process conflicting advertisements for transactions, as they cannot be both accepted into our mempool. Avoid processing these and doing spurious work.'
result.scope_notes: Clean cherry-pick backport of commit 1278a5970d5ada0979052a5bad899e896b8ab40b from master PR #35878.
result.card: Backports PR #35878 to the 31.x maintenance branch to ensure net_processing handles only unique transaction inventory advertisements. This prevents nodes from doing spurious work on conflicting transaction announcements that cannot both be accepted into the mempool. The patch is a clean cherry-pick of an already merged commit on master.

risk.why: Flaws in transaction INV filtering could prevent nodes from requesting or relaying valid transactions across the P2P network.
